And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye' (20:39).

chapters.heading: The Heart of a Mother
chapters.body: 'And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river]' (28:8). 'And the wife of Pharaoh said, «[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son.» And they perceived not' (28:9). 'And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers' (28:10). She said to his sister, 'Follow him'; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not (28:11).

chapters.heading: Returned, as Promised
chapters.body: 'And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, «Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?»' (28:12). 'So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know' (28:13).

familyQuestion: Musa's mother trusted Allah's promise when it was hard. When have you had to trust Allah before you could see the result?

title: Zakariya (Zechariah)
subtitle: He called his Lord privately for an heir, and Allah gave him Yahya
sources: Qur'an 19:2-11 — the private supplication
Qur'an 3:37-41 — in the care of Maryam
Qur'an 21:89-90 — 'do not leave me alone'
Qur'an 6:85 — among the righteous
Sahih Muslim 2379 — 'Zakariyya was a carpenter'

chapters.heading: A Private Supplication
chapters.body: '[This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah When he called to his Lord a private supplication. He said, «My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy. And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]»' (19:2-6). In Surah al-Anbiya: 'My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors' (21:89). In Surah Al Imran his prayer came in the prayer chamber, where Maryam was in his care and he found provision with her: 'O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?' She said, 'It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account' (3:37). Then Zechariah called upon his Lord, 'grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication' (3:38).

chapters.heading: The Good News
chapters.body: 'The angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, «Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous»' (3:39). 'O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name' (19:7). He said, 'My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?' (19:8). The answer: 'Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, «It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing»' (19:9). Allah says: 'We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive' (21:90).

chapters.heading: The Sign
chapters.body: He said, 'My Lord, make for me a sign.' He said, 'Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound' (19:10). Surah Al Imran says: 'you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning' (3:41). 'So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon' (19:11). He is counted among the righteous (6:85). The Prophet ﷺ said, as Abu Hurayrah reported: 'Zakariyya (peace be upon him) was a carpenter' (Sahih Muslim 2379).

familyQuestion: Zakariya called Allah quietly for years. Which du'a are you still waiting on, and can you keep calling with hope?
